question: How was the teaching transmitted among the earth-moving yoginīs?
premises: They are described as good eaters
inference: The teaching was told by an earth-mover to the earth-moving yoginīs.
uncertainties: subhakṣāṇāṃ may be an epithet or a specific group name
plain_english: O beloved, it was told by an earth-mover to the earth-moving yoginīs, the good eaters.
